scenarios.name: Explain Auto capability before listening
scenarios.given: Apple Intelligence is selected and Auto is saved on or off
scenarios.when: the idle workspace opens and the enabled preference is turned off
scenarios.then: manual-only guidance is visible before recording, unavailable Auto cannot be enabled, and the provider, stored preference and recording remain under user control

scenarios.name: Prioritize phone speech and name summary actions
scenarios.given: a portrait conversation contains speech and summary output with correction off
scenarios.when: the workspace appears and correction settings are opened from transcript options
scenarios.then: the transcript occupies at least 43 percent of combined panel height, optional correction setup does not consume reading space, Update is labeled with a 44 point target, and expanding or configuring speech stays reachable; its accessible name matches the visible Update action; compact Duo keeps the authored transcript and Quick text entirely within their readers with the same 44-point Update target

scenarios.name: Name and group conversation tools
scenarios.given: a conversation has notes and optional AI tools
scenarios.when: More opens Notes, prompts & files and returns
scenarios.then: notes and a named Ask AI section are reachable without changing the familiar Notes shortcut or starting capture; the full-summary reader exposes its own present, correctly labeled action and explains disabled empty input

scenarios.name: Name the recording device on Watch
scenarios.given: Watch local recording is available while the phone is offline
scenarios.when: home and the remote section are read and local recording starts and stops
scenarios.then: Record on Watch and Start on iPhone distinguish the devices, offline remote stays disabled, and Stop on Watch remains reachable

scenarios.name: Keep optional Mac configuration collapsed and reachable
scenarios.given: optional Mac language controls are in a workspace disclosure with an explicit French target
scenarios.when: the workspace opens and a native settings disclosure is activated
scenarios.then: the content starts collapsed, a native pointer action reveals the actual language controls, and opening them preserves the saved choices without a save or translation request

manual.reason: The native component test does not establish full workspace integration or actual AI requests.
steps: In the source-matched installed Dev app open and close Recording settings, AI models, Session details and More Quick actions.
Verify engine/language/model choices remain unchanged and every secondary action remains visible after expansion; do not invoke a provider just to inspect controls.
Retain native screenshots, AX readback and source/signing provenance; physical capture acceptance remains separate.

scenarios.name: Keep playback reachable without recognized speech
scenarios.given: a saved portrait conversation contains notes and retained audio but no recognized transcript lines
scenarios.when: Transcript actions opens the saved audio reader and returns
scenarios.then: Play recording, the player and audio sharing remain reachable without starting capture
